fluid_cognition.law: The physics IS the thinking. Cognition runs on fluid dynamics, not on metaphors about fluid dynamics.
fluid_cognition.transport: Advection-diffusion dc/dt + (u . grad) c = D laplacian c + s. Information rides the flow; D is literally forgetting.

calculus.navier_stokes_origin: Derived from mass/momentum balances on infinitesimal control volumes via the divergence theorem.
calculus.vorticity_transport: D omega/Dt = (omega . grad) u + nu laplacian omega — pressure drops because curl(grad p) = 0; div omega = 0 keeps vortex lines from ending. In 2D: D omega/Dt = nu laplacian omega = pure advection-diffusion of vorticity = memory.
calculus.information_transport: dc/dt = div(D grad c) - div(v c) + R, derived from the scalar conservation law + Gauss's theorem. Buoyancy enters as a body-force/source term.
calculus.honest_limit: Navier-Stokes global smooth existence is a Clay Millennium open problem — engineer with viscous regularization.
